title: Preflight questionnaire scorecard and escalation playbook
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit lengthy vendor questionnaires, DPAs, and security checklists during onboarding. Current intake is manual, inconsistent, and blocks sales & onboarding. Goal: build a preflight scorecard that automatically parses incoming questionnaires (PDF/Docx/Google Form), extracts key signals (data residency, PHI, third-party transfers, encryption at rest, SOC2 controls), assigns a risk tier, auto-populates recommended evidence bundles, and either auto-responds or routes to the appropriate lane (Legal, Security, Solutions, or Sales escalations). This ticket defines the product playbook, acceptance criteria, and escalation SLAs for an initial beta with three enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest: System can accept questionnaire attachments via ticket form and email-to-intake with >85% parsing success for structured fields (yes/no/controlled).
Scorecard: Generate a deterministic score and risk-tier (Low/Medium/High) with an explanation blob for each decision within 30s of ingest.
Auto-respond: For Low-tier only, auto-generate a templated response and attach a pre-approved evidence bundle; UX includes editable draft before send.
Escalation: High-tier triggers routing to Security + Legal with pre-filled issue in Linear and a recommended SLA (T0: 8h) and triage checklist.
Audit trail: All parsing decisions, human edits, and final responses are logged and exportable for audits (CSV + Confluence link).
Metrics: Dashboard surfaces intake volume, parse success, false-positive escalations, average time-to-resolution by tier.
Pilot: Run with 3 named enterprise customers for 6 weeks and report outcomes (reduction in door-knock time, percentage auto-resolved).
updates: 2025-02-12 Sofia Ramirez: Kickoff - scoped MVP features with Legal (A. Patel) and Security (M. Zhang). Identified required extraction fields and initial evidence bundle templates.
2025-02-14 Ethan Cole: Wireframes reviewed — added 'editable draft' step to reduce risk of incorrect auto-responses after PM/Legal feedback.

2025-02-15 Engineering sync (K. Nguyen): Confirmed ingestion pipeline using existing docs-parse Lambda and a light-weight NER model. Trade-off: accept 85% parse for MVP to avoid doubling dev effort on edge-case formats.

2025-02-16 Legal review (A. Patel): Approved evidence bundle set for Low-tier auto-respond but requires explicit checkbox for customer consent before sending. Added compliance flag for cross-border data transfer.
2025-02-17 Design review (L. Morgan): Updated UI copy to surface reasons behind score and added link to 'appeal' flow for customers to request re-review.

2025-02-18 Product decision: Proceed to build with rollout plan: pilot customers = AcmeHealth, FinSpark, and GlobalRetail. SLA targets set: Low auto-respond within 60s, Medium manual triage within 48h, High triage within 8h.
resolution_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): parsing + deterministic heuristics + manual override UI. Phase 2: ML calibration on historical tickets, feedback loop, and expand auto-respond rules. Operational runbook to include escalation contacts, SLA timers, and a daily intake digest for Security. Rollout: pilot → 3 customers → measure → iterate → wider launch tied to console-2025.03 release.
notes: Risk: false auto-responses could expose incorrect contractual statements. Mitigations: conservative auto-respond only when parsed fields map to pre-approved evidence and add a mandatory human review opt-out flag for Legal. Also plan spam/garbage doc heuristic to avoid consuming compute for irrelevant attachments.
